$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080. The slide rules are the illustration skill's (section 6, Deck slide): the lockup top left at 64, a Gilroy 104 headline bottom left, and a drawing that may bleed off the right and bottom; the posts' 48 and 64 margins and their logomark bottom right. Statement, chart, closing and poster slides are the share-image layouts (image.json posters) drawn at 1920 by 1080. Each type has its ground (bone, green, brown, black) and sample copy from the share-image tool's occasions; every word is meant to be replaced.

cover.description: The lockup top left, a big headline and a line under it bottom left, a wireframe scene bleeding off the right and bottom.

sample.title: Physical world context for AI agents
sample.subtitle: One API to connect your agents to physical world data, enrichment, tools and signals.

section.description: A section label in DM Mono over a tick row, the section title bottom left, the sparse contours behind.

statement.description: One sentence in a clear window framed by the grid, with the lockup above it (the window poster).

sample.title: Every value your agent returns is cited.
sample.subtitle: Ownership, flood, terrain and utilities for any U.S. parcel.

bullets.description: A title and up to six points, each led by a diamond and parted by a 1px rule.

sample.title: What your agent can ask
sample.items: Who owns this parcel? | Is it in a flood zone? | How steep is the terrain? | How far is the nearest substation?

stat.description: A big number, a line under it and a tick row filled to the share it names (ticks show state).

sample.title: fields returned for data center siting
sample.subtitle: Every field cited to its source.

quote.description: A quote led by a solid diamond and an attribution in DM Mono.

sample.quote: We sent hundreds of locations in one call, and one bad address did not fail the rest.

image.description: A title and a line at the left, your picture in a cut frame at the right (--image); without one, a wireframe scene.

sample.title: Find the parcels that fit.
sample.subtitle: Send hundreds of locations in one call.

chart.description: A hatched column chart under the headline (the chart poster).

poster.description: Any share-image poster laid out at 1920 by 1080 (--template: parcels, scene, tag, panel, app, partner, ...).

sample.title: Find the parcels that fit.
sample.subtitle: Send hundreds of locations in one call, and one bad address does not fail the rest.

closing.description: The lockup in a clear window on the dense contours (the identity poster) and the address in DM Mono at the foot.

agenda.description: A title and the agenda: numbered rows in DM Mono, each parted by a 1px rule (items split by |).

sample.title: Agenda
sample.items: Why physical world context | The API in one call | What agents ask | Questions

team.description: A title and up to six people as cards, each a contour tile over the words you give ("Role" or "Name, Role"; no photos are drawn).

sample.title: The team
sample.items: Engineering lead, Acme | Data lead, Acme | Design lead, Acme

timeline.description: A title and a line of milestones, each a diamond with its when and what (items: "When: what" split by |).

sample.title: The year ahead
sample.items: Q1: Batch calls | Q2: MCP tools | Q3: Parcel history | Q4: Global coverage

gallery.description: A title and two to four of your pictures in cut frames on a grid (images split by |).

questions.description: Your closing words (a question prompt you write) on the dense contours, with the lockup and an optional address.
